text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, what momentum...! Is she shifting 
into an even higher gear—?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...So strong.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(It's completely different from the 
'Satsuki Sho.' Far more so than back 
then—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: More, I need even more...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Just how strong do you want to become? 
Do you still intend to keep growing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That strength of yours is just far too 
arrogant.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "...If that's how it is. Then I won't—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
“—I want wings to surpass you, my idol, 
someday, and take flight toward the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I can't let it end here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This year's Derby Umamusume is Sakura 
Laurel! The victory goes to Sakura 
Laurel!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainer... san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I catch Sakura Laurel in my arms to 
prevent any further strain on her legs.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Trainer-san. But you know... 
I'm all right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The final line... I managed to properly 
defend it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want it to end yet. I want to be 
more like her—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to reach what lies 
ahead...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We place Sakura Laurel on the hastily 
summoned stretcher and rush her to the 
doctor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even then, however, the light in her eyes 
shone—intensely and brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Nn..., mmph...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Trainer...? Is this... the waiting 
room...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After taking Sakura Laurel to the doctor, 
I explained that there was nothing wrong 
with her legs.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, tension and fatigue must have 
accumulated in her body. After the 
examination, she slept for quite some 
time, leading up to now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, that's true, wasn't it... 
..................

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Brian-chan's running really was 
amazing after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You just purely seek speed, and keep 
accelerating. Endlessly, endlessly...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...I believe my victory today was almost 
entirely down to luck.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure that in the remaining Kikuka 
Sho, Brian-chan will show us an incredibly 
powerful run."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
With that arrogant, blindingly brilliant 
run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I won't give up either. I'll keep 
chasing after that back of hers."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: To fulfill the dream that lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLICK!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Laurel-zaaaan...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Wah...!? Both of you...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry. ...Thank 
you for caring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while, Sakura Laurel continued to 
gently stroke the heads of the two who had 
come to the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work. Let's wrap 
it up here for today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And just as I was about to wave, I 
suddenly recalled how Sakura Laurel had 
looked just moments ago."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering her physical condition, our 
goals, and everything involved, entering 
the Japanese Derby this time was the 
result of careful deliberation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I can't imagine wanting to repeat 
the same thing going forward.
choice_data_list:
(So that someday she can chase her dream 
with everything she's got...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'll protect my dream no matter what.
I will definitely protect my dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel looks ahead. Straight toward 
the ideal she yearns for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —She hesitates no longer.
